title: i18n: a translation fault (getLocales/getTranslations throws) blanks list_datasets and refuses query_dataset (503) instead of serving untranslated text — the same on object tools and REST /meta
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (6962345006). A follow-up of #34876, under epic #34659 (it affects ask-data).

## What happens (premise reading on #34876, area o3-A, report 6962311179, main db1a05cdae)
- When the i18n service resolves but `getLocales` or `getTranslations` throws, `translationBundleOf` (packages/rest `meta-item-read-gate.ts` ~3264/3268) calls both reads with no guard, so `translateMetaList` rejects.
- The MCP dataset loaders do not catch the rejection on either transport (`stdio-data-bridge.ts` ~1483, runtime `domains/mcp.ts` ~1600).
- The executor then degrades the whole read: `list_datasets` answers `datasets: []` with `partial: true`, and `query_dataset` answers **503**. One translation fault blanks the catalogue and refuses every query.
- Read only, not measured: the object tools use the same unguarded translator (`stdio-data-bridge.ts` ~1207, `mcp.ts` ~1038), and so does REST /meta.

## Change
A translation fault serves **untranslated text with a warning** on all three surfaces together. This changes a served answer (Clause-② yes, widening) and deliberately flips #34876's pin (the seat ruled #34876 to pin today's degraded answer, tests only).

Parent: #34659.
Grade: **p2 · domain:server** (themes: MCP and zh-CN). The effect is total, but the trigger (a throwing i18n read) is rare and no customer is named.
